artworks.title: The Farnese Bull
artworks.artist: Apollonius of Tralles and Tauriscus of Tralles (Roman copy)
artworks.year: c. 2nd century BC (original); Roman marble copy
artworks.description: The colossal Naples group shows Amphion and Zethus binding Dirce to the bull — the twin sons of Zeus and Antiope avenging their mother, Amphion the lyre-builder of Thebes cast as a marble giant.

artworks.title: Amphion Building the Walls of Thebes
artworks.description: A Rijksmuseum allegory titles the miracle: Amphion's lyre draws the stones into Thebes' walls — 'suaviter et fortiter,' soft music as civic force.

artworks.title: Amphion
artworks.description: From the Temple of the Muses series: Amphion with his lyre — the Theban twin whose music, Hermes-gifted, made masonry follow the tune.
